title: Investigation into Allegations against State Commission Members

content.scenario: A consumer complaint is filed against a member of the State Consumer Commission in Maharashtra, alleging bias in a recent judgment. The National Commission initiates an investigation into the allegations.
content.outcome: The National Commission submits an inquiry report to the Maharashtra State Government, along with a copy endorsed to the Central Government, for necessary action against the State Commission member.

user_queries: How does the National Commission investigate allegations against State Commission members?
What is the process for addressing consumer complaints against State Commission members?
Can the National Commission take action against State Commission members?
